title: [R1] Export PR machine routing decisions
brief:
Approved product-owner specification for an AgentLoom developer utility. Use only Node built-ins. Add exactly the specified script, a native node:test .mjs file, and one documentation file. Do not change any existing tracked file, package.json, existing tests or application source. No product, architecture or scope decisions are delegated. npm ci --include=dev is authorized in the run workspace. The platform independently runs the focused test file, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build, and node /pilot/verify-compose.mjs. The last command builds an isolated image from the run's fresh dist, starts a separate Compose service, probes health, empty runs and the webpage, records source/image identities, then cleans up. This recorded command satisfies AGENTS.md Docker Compose validation. Complete logs and historical failures are provided in the assigned validation evidence packet. Agents must not create Docker stacks, publish, push, commit or merge. The controller owns publication. Approving this plan permits two Flash repairs and one Fable rescue, each followed by fresh validation and independent Astra review. Only AC1-AC3 and SCOPE are code acceptance criteria. Planned fault injection/restart/publication recovery are external experiment controls, not extra code acceptance criteria and not evidence that must exist before publication. Keep the plan concise (under 400 words), preserve AC IDs and end PLAN_READY. Do not ask questions already resolved here.

AC1: Add scripts/summarize-routing.mjs exporting summarizeRouting(run). Input run.id and run.status are strings; automation absent yields {runId:id,status,repairsUsed:0,escalationUsed:false,decisions:[]}. Present automation must be an object with repairsUsed a nonnegative safe integer and decisions an array. Optional escalation must be an object with used boolean. Each decision requires choice/action strings and finite confidence 0..1; optional offeredActions is an array of strings. Return exactly {runId,status,repairsUsed,escalationUsed,decisions}, where each decision projects {choice,action,confidence,offeredActions} (absent offeredActions becomes null). Never include task, prompts, reason, logs or credentials. Do not mutate input; ignore unused extra fields.
AC2: Direct CLI node scripts/summarize-routing.mjs RUN_JSON_FILE reads only the local file, prints formatted JSON plus newline and exits 0. Missing/extra arguments exit 2 with concise stderr only. Read/JSON/projected-shape errors exit 1 stderr only, with no raw file content or stack. Export invalid shapes throw TypeError. Import has no side effects. No network or child processes.
AC3: Add tests/summarize-routing-cli.test.mjs for absent automation, complete/escalated/paused routes, boundary confidences, malformed nested fields, field omission and non-mutation, plus real CLI success/read/JSON/shape/usage failures and side-effect-free import. Document commands, exit codes and projection limits in docs/tools/summarize-routing.md. Exactly these three files change.
